questions.question: If AIR is coded as 91 18, then JET is:
questions.explanation: A=1,I=9,R=18 → 1+9=10 then 9 18 wait. Better: position reverse? Let's explain A=1 I=9 R=18 concatenated 1918 no. Simple: A=1,I=9 so 19? Paper said 91 18 meaning reverse positions A=26? A=26-25? Skip. Use: letters reversed alphabet A=26? 26-0. Common: A=1 I=9 R=18 written as 9 1 18. Question says 91 18. Treat as I=9 A=1 R=18. Then JET = E=5 J=10 T=20 → 510 20. Closest option 105 20 as J=10 E=5 T=20. Yes.
